locator.section: OE+. rearrangements: gamma-H/beta-cleavage; ketosteroid/tricyclic stereochemistry (< 1.8 A gamma-H rule)

evidence.curator_note: This is the productive endo path: the m/z 82 cyclopentadienol ion is drawn with 'm/z 82, 17%'. PRECURSOR: an endo/exo pair of stereoisomeric ketones drawn as bicyclic/tricyclic cages; they are the dicyclopentadiene-derived tricyclo[5.2.1.0^2,6]decan-one (a norbornane fused to a cyclopentane, C10H14O). The exact carbonyl position and the endo/exo configuration are read from a schematic 3D drawing and are DISCLOSED as uncertain; the constitutional SMILES here places the carbonyl on the two-carbon bridge (C9) of the norbornane unit. Stereochemistry (endo vs exo) is NOT encoded in the SMILES, yet it is the whole point of Eq 8.25: the text (Djerassi/Tokes 1966; Kingston 1974; Herzschuh 1983) states the gamma-H must be < 1.8 A from C=O, so ONLY the endo-isomer (a) undergoes the tandem gamma-H/beta-cleavage rearrangement. NET REACTION: C10H14O+. -> cyclopentadienol radical cation (hydroxycyclopentadiene C5H6O+., m/z 82) + cyclopentene (C5H8). TWO-STEP TANDEM DRAWN BY THE BOOK, COLLAPSED HERE: the page draws (i) a gamma-H rearrangement (arrow labelled 'rH', 3 arcs on the ketone panel) to an explicitly-drawn BRACKETED enol radical-cation intermediate (a cis-fused bis-cyclopentane dienol, [ ]+.), then (ii) a retro-Diels-Alder / beta-cleavage (second 'rH', ~4 arcs on the bracketed intermediate) that splits the two rings. This record encodes the NET fragmentation as ONE net_fragmentation step (the drawn enol intermediate is real and covalent but is not separately encoded here); ~7 fishhook arcs are drawn across the two-step scheme, whereas the NET bond changes are 4 closed-shell 2-electron shifts. RADICAL/CHARGE LOCALISATION (convention C): the odd electron is a SPECTATOR of the net bond changes (it starts and ends on oxygen); the book draws the product +. delocalised over the ring, but this record localises the hole on the enol oxygen (O+., an oxygen-centred resonance form of the hydroxycyclopentadiene radical cation). H-PROVENANCE CAVEAT: in the collapsed net the transferred (hydroxyl) H is formally sourced from C8 (alpha in this atom numbering); the book's stepwise mechanism transfers a gamma-H (1,5) in the first rH step - a net atom-map cannot preserve the stepwise H provenance, so the encoded H-source is a bookkeeping artefact of the collapse, not a claim that C8 is the gamma-carbon. [record = panel a (endo isomer, reacts)]
